summary: SRanger controller written in package sranger (9 Java files): one controller with modes MOVING (initial), TURNING, FINAL (terminal); six transitions plus the initial mode, one per SR-Beh requirement; guards obstacleDetected and turnDurationElapsed; clockResetTime as a clock variable. All 23 requirements are traced in result_codegen.json. Ten points are flagged: two invented defaults, one ambiguity (trigger plus guard on Moving to Turning), one model-rounding note, and six design choices.

issues.title: Sensor distance when no reading is available: 100.0 m
issues.raw: SR-DM5: 'When no reading is available ... distance() returns a large default value so that the obstacle-detection condition is not falsely triggered by missing data.' No number is given.
issues.fix_directive: If a specific default is wanted, change NO_READING_DISTANCE in Sensor.java; any value above OBSTACLE_THRESHOLD (and above 1, its rounded model value) keeps the intent.

issues.title: Initial values before the first assignment: clockResetTime = 0.0, actuator last command (0, 0)
issues.raw: SR-Var1 says clockResetTime is set on entry to Turning but gives no initial value; SR-DM6 does not say what the actuator reports before any command. The controller constructor issues Move(moveVel, 0) at once, so the actuator's (0, 0) is never observable after construction.
issues.fix_directive: Change the field initialisers if other initial values are required.

issues.title: Move carries two real components (lv, av) in one event record
issues.raw: SR-DM4: 'a single output event, Move, carrying two real values'. The profile describes an event with one record component; the requirement fixes two values and forbids other output events, so Move is one record with two @RoboChartType("real") components rather than a wrapper record or two events.
issues.fix_directive: If the pipeline needs a single component, introduce a value record (e.g. Velocity(lv, av)) and make Move carry it; keep a single output event.

issues.title: Moving to Turning uses both the obstacle event and the obstacleDetected guard
issues.raw: SR-Beh2 names only the obstacle event as the trigger; SR-GP1 states that obstacleDetected (distance <= obstacleThreshold) is the guard on the same transition. Both are honoured: trigger obstacle, condition obstacleDetected. An obstacle event while the reading is above the threshold is ignored.
issues.fix_directive: If the event alone should suffice, drop '&& obstacleDetected' from the Moving block (SR-GP1 would then be unused).

issues.title: Turning: autonomous return placed above the tick self-loop; tick guarded by !turnDurationElapsed
issues.raw: SR-Beh5 (autonomous, turnDurationElapsed) and SR-Beh7 (tick self-loop, no condition) have equal priority. A tick arrives every control cycle, so a tick branch above the timed branch would keep the robot turning forever. Order in Turning: endTask, then turnDurationElapsed, then tick && !turnDurationElapsed (the negation is required below a predicate-only branch, and makes the two transitions mutually exclusive in the model). endTask is first in both Moving and Turning as the override.
issues.fix_directive: None expected; revisit only if the timed transition should yield to tick.

issues.title: Tick self-loops perform no action; entry actions are inlined only on transitions that change mode
issues.raw: SR-Beh4 and SR-Beh7: 'The controller performs no action on this transition.' The Turning entry actions (clockResetTime reset, Move(0, turnVel)) are therefore not repeated on the Turning tick self-loop; repeating the clock reset would prevent the timed return.

issues.title: Power-up entry command Move(moveVel, 0) issued in the controller constructor
issues.raw: SR-Beh1 (start in Moving) with SR-FR1 (on entering Moving issue Move(moveVel, 0)). The initial mode is the field initialiser; the entry command of the initial entry is issued once in the constructor, since step() holds only transitions out of a mode.
issues.fix_directive: If the extracted model must carry this as Moving's initial entry action and does not, report it as a pipeline limitation rather than adding a transition (SR-DC1).

issues.title: OBSTACLE_THRESHOLD = 0.5 is rounded up to 1 in the model's constants interface
issues.raw: SR-DM2 fixes obstacleThreshold = 0.5, and the guard obstacleDetected (SR-GP1) compares against it. Per the profile, a fractional constant becomes the next integer in the model, so the model's guard reads distance() <= 1. The Java keeps the exact 0.5. moveVel, turnVel and turnDuration are integral and unaffected.
issues.fix_directive: None in the Java (the value is fixed by the requirement); interpret model-level results on obstacleDetected with this rounding in mind.

issues.title: Sensor ignores negative or NaN readings
issues.raw: SR-DM5/SR-SF1: distance() is non-negative. update() keeps the previous value when given a reading that is not >= 0.0, so distance() never returns a negative or NaN value.

issues.title: Clock is monotonic time in seconds since the clock was created
issues.raw: SR-Var1 records 'the current time' without naming a time source. Clock.now() returns seconds from System.nanoTime() relative to construction; the controller field is named timer because 'clock' is a reserved word.

next_step: Run the pipeline (compile, coverage, profile check, transformations, verifiers). No change to the Java is planned before that run.
